en: Illustrated postcard showing the skyline of Strasbourg with the tall Gothic spire of Strasbourg Cathedral rising above the city. To the right, large white storks fly across the sky carrying French tricolor flags with golden fringes and symbols, evoking liberation or national celebration. The dates 1870 and 1918 flank the cathedral, and the word 'Strasbourg' appears in decorative script. A small artist signature is at the lower right.
